name: io.github.acidka/chandelier
title: Chandelier
description: Drive Adobe Illustrator fast: ~5 ms calls, batches, ExtendScript, preflight, PDF/X export.

environmentVariables.name: CHANDELIER_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool profile: full (default), lean, or a comma-separated list of tool names

environmentVariables.name: CHANDELIER_LOG
environmentVariables.description: debug: one JSON line per tool call on stderr

environmentVariables.name: CHANDELIER_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Append the debug log to this file
